topic.readerProblem: Choose n8n cloud execution capacity without an unnecessary self-hosted upgrade.
topic.connection: Historical adjacent software article retained for existing readers and URL continuity; not a new AEOeye core-topic endorsement or quota item.

assessment: Corrected the false implication that 12000 runs require Business and that 50000 require Enterprise. The guide now includes official Cloud Pro-2 capacity, real public selector observations and a reproducible extra-execution example. EUR static offers and US browser dollar offers are clearly separated rather than silently converted.

sources.supports: Official support confirms Pro-2 50000 monthly executions. Read-only US browser selector showed $120/month annual-equivalent and $144 month-to-month. Monthly 60000-run example is 144+10*2=$164 before tax. Annual invoice, EUR Pro-2 checkout and actual purchased cost are not claimed.
